answer_1.quote: We constructed Simul-MuST-C, a new large‑scale training dataset for SiST, using the segment‑based monotonic method, i.e., salami technique, across multiple language pairs: English-to-Japanese (En‑Ja), English-to-German (En‑De), and English-to-Chinese (En‑Zh). ... Training models with Simul‑MuST‑C in speech‑to‑text settings improves latency minimization and translation quality.

answer_2.quote: We used four distinct metrics, which were chosen because each evaluates using different criteria: BLEU, BLEURT, COMET, and COMET‑QE. ... We evaluated latency using the SimulEval toolkit. We selected Average Lagging (AL), Length Adaptive Average Lagging (LAAL), and Average Token Delay (ATD).
